front: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the ONLY approved Zhuzha bee design. Produce a faithful FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW (0 degrees) of this exact same character, by changing only the camera angle from three-quarter to front. This is a turnaround illustration for later 3D modeling, NOT a redesign. LOCK anatomy and proportions to the supplied drawing: same compact continuous body, same ratio of body height to width, same head volume and lower abdomen, same relatively small brown faceted antenna balls and stem thickness/length, same black faceted oval eye height and width, same pink cheeks, same small subtle smile. Do NOT enlarge antenna tips, smile or body width. Preserve body-relative wing size and thin pale translucent cream polygon wing shapes with gold outline, rear shoulder attachments, calm open rest pose. Preserve the approved warm yellow-orange colors and large irregular facets, dark broad stripe beneath face, honey lower stripe and dark lower band. Re-express only perspective: eyes centered and equally projected, both sides visible equally, symmetrical anatomy (lighting remains warmer/brighter upper-left). Body is slightly upright-tilted as original, not a spherical or egg replacement, no separate head/thorax/abdomen, no pear silhouette. Match original rendering style without extra polygons or fine mosaic. Full bee, antenna tips and feet included with margin. True transparent background, no shadow, no labels, no crown, no accessories. The small smile and restrained antenna knobs are particularly important; copy their proportion from image 1 exactly.
